# Recreation Prompt

Create a browser-native portrait-first supermarket simulator called **Bestie Bento Market Simulator**. Preserve a simple one-thumb resource-management loop: the player drags to move a small clerk, collects stock from a supply station, fills built shelves, autonomous customers buy from stocked shelves, checkout money accumulates, the player collects it, and money buys additional shelves. Keep capacities, payment, day timer, upgrade/shop, and day-end semantics stable.

Transform the presentation into a satirical cozy Ghibli-adjacent weekend grocery world with decora kei, soft girl, and kidcore cues. The focal actor is a mint-green ribboned Bestie Clerk. Stock is bento snacks, shelves are cute kidcore racks, customers are pastel besties, checkout is a receipt nest, money is receipts, and failure/blocked feedback uses small meme-tone cues such as "real" and "bestie." Use procedural Canvas/CSS art, pastel pink/mint/lilac/yellow palette, rounded clay forms, sticker/cloud ambience, readable mobile HUD, and short actionable CTAs.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source game truth
The preserved source is a single-screen canvas supermarket/resource-management game. The player moves with a drag joystick, collects stock from a supply station, deposits it into built shelves, waits for autonomous customers to buy stocked items, collects checkout money, buys additional shelves, and repeats until the in-game day reaches 21:00.

## Protected mechanics
- One-thumb pointer joystick movement and boundary clamping.
- Stock pickup radius, player max stock 5, shelf max stock 4, and built shelf gating.
- Customer spawn cap based on built shelves, customer shopping/payment/leaving state flow, and $15 payment per bought item.
- Checkout proximity collection and money accumulation.
- Upgrade shop costs and day-end state.

## Safe transformation surfaces
- Title, HUD vocabulary, UI styling, canvas forms, background scene, entity silhouettes, feedback copy, fonts, compact SFX/GIF accents, and progression wording.

## Remixed target
Bestie Bento Market Simulator keeps the protected supermarket simulator loop while changing the public identity into a cozy satirical, Ghibli-adjacent, decora-kidcore weekend market tycoon with a recognizable mint mascot clerk and pastel bento aisle world.
